title: The Complete Poetry and Essential Prose of John Milton
author_or_editor: William Kerrigan, John Rumrich, and Stephen M. Fallon (eds.)
reliability_notes: The standard one-volume complete Milton; used for poem and prose texts, dating, and the canon. Complements the Oxford and Yale editions.

title: The Poems of Andrew Marvell
reliability_notes: The standard annotated edition of Marvell's complete poems (Longman Annotated English Poets); used for texts, dates, and commentary.

title: The English Poems of George Herbert
reliability_notes: The standard scholarly edition of Herbert's English poems with full commentary; used for The Temple's texts and structure.

title: The Diary of Samuel Pepys
publisher: Bell & Hyman / University of California Press
reliability_notes: The definitive eleven-volume edition of the complete diary (1970–1983); used for Pepys's text, dating, and the events of 1660–1669.

title: Leviathan: The English and Latin Texts
publisher: Clarendon Press (Clarendon Edition of the Works of Thomas Hobbes)
reliability_notes: The authoritative Clarendon parallel-text edition; used for Leviathan's text and the variants between the 1651 English and 1668 Latin versions.

title: The Pilgrim's Progress
reliability_notes: Standard scholarly edition of Bunyan's allegory, both parts, with introduction and notes; used for the text and its variants.

title: The Poems and Fables of John Dryden
reliability_notes: The standard one-volume edition of Dryden's poems; used for texts and dating, alongside the California edition of the plays and prose.

title: The Major Works of Sir Thomas Browne
reliability_notes: Standard edition of Religio Medici, Hydriotaphia, The Garden of Cyrus, and other major prose; used for texts and Browne's canon.

title: The Works of Aphra Behn
publisher: William Pickering / Ohio State University Press
reliability_notes: The standard six-volume collected edition (1992–1996) of Behn's plays, prose, and verse; used for texts, dates, and the canon.

title: Metaphysical Lyrics and Poems of the Seventeenth Century: Donne to Butler
reliability_notes: Grierson's foundational two-volume anthology, which established 'metaphysical' as a critical category; used for texts of Herbert, Crashaw, Vaughan, Cowley, and their contemporaries.

title: Kissing the Rod: An Anthology of Seventeenth-Century Women's Verse
author_or_editor: Germaine Greer, Susan Hastings, Jeslyn Medoff, and Melinda Sansone (eds.)
reliability_notes: Landmark anthology of women's poetry of the period; used for texts and attributions of Philips, Finch, Cavendish, Bradstreet, and other women writers.

title: The Cambridge Companion to English Literature, 1650–1740
reliability_notes: Authoritative survey essays on the literature of the Restoration and early eighteenth century; used for period context and generic framing.

title: The Cambridge Companion to Milton, 2nd edition
reliability_notes: Standard collection of essays on Milton's poetry and prose; used for interpretation, context, and the state of scholarship.

title: The Cambridge Companion to Restoration Drama
reliability_notes: Authoritative survey of the Restoration stage, its playwrights, companies, and genres; used for context and attribution of plays.

title: The Norton Anthology of English Literature, 10th edition, Volume C: Restoration and the Eighteenth Century
reliability_notes: Standard classroom anthology for 1660–1785; used for canonical selection, texts, and introductions.
